name: Reading tables, charts, and graphs
definition: Getting information out of a chart means reading the axes and the key first, then the bars or points. Most errors here are not mathematical: they are reading the wrong row, missing that the scale goes up in fives, or ignoring the units in the title.
recognizeWhen: the graph shows the temperature each day
how many more chose one than the other
misconceptions: I assumed each gridline on the scale was worth one.
I read the value from the wrong row of the table.
I answered how many rather than how many more.
